summary: Strong induction on i. The step function F of the sieve system at level i (the integrand of J_i in the last entry) is nonnegative and integrable. After rescaling and restriction to the adeles integral outside T, the resulting function is lower semicontinuous at the rational points t ∈ V, where the entries are units. One-sided Poisson summation there bounds the diagonal sum by c_i times (the zero Fourier coefficient J_i(…) plus the sum of the other Fourier coefficients); the latter are bounded through β by ε(ΣΛ)², and J_i(…) by the induction hypothesis (and the off-diagonal bound for the unequal entries).

steps.lean: intro hd c hΓ

steps.claim: Strong induction: fix i with the claim for all smaller indices (ih), i ≤ n (hi), V ⊆ A (hV).
steps.lean: refine Nat.strongRec fun i ih hi V hV ↦ ?_

    _ fun _ _ ↦ dite_eq_left rfl, (isOpen_univ.prod (isOpen_integralOff T) : @IsOpen (𝔸 E) _
        _), this,
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ c i), LinearMap.det_pi (S.frameScaleSq · i • (1 : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ))

steps.claim: F is nonnegative (N). The function ofReal(Re F) is lower semicontinuous wherever all the updated input sequences are continuous (L). The adelic set U of points integral outside T is open (o). F is integrable (hF), its integral is the sum of the level-i kernels over p and q (e), and at each unit frequency ξ the norm of its Fourier integral is at most β(ξ)(Σ_p Λ_i(hd(i,p,1)))² (hM). The scale c_i is nonnegative and d gives the determinant of the archimedean rescaling.
steps.lean:
show 0 ≤ F ∧ _ from K.nonneg_and_lowerSemicontinuous hi
    _ fun _ _ ↦ dite_eq_left rfl, (isOpen_univ.prod (isOpen_integralOff T) : @IsOpen (𝔸 E) _
        _), this,
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ c i), LinearMap.det_pi (S.frameScaleSq · i • (1 : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ))
